overallFormula: round(0.65 * 73 + 0.35 * 25) = 56; planning proxy, not a readiness certification
ratingRules: Increment source feature coverage only for distinct implemented/tested user-visible or functional modules
Never count documentation-only tasks or cosmetic revisions as substantive completed features
Require backend, web, Windows, docs, backup and budget CI GREEN on protected main
Require separately witnessed Windows, HA/MQTT/camera, peer mTLS and backup testing to raise field acceptance
When evidence does not support a five-point gain, preserve lower percentage and explain shortfall
Avoid double-counting the same work in later builds; source and field readiness are separate
